privacy.ai_training_note: Trelent negotiates Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreements with upstream AI providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic) so those providers process data but never store, log, or reuse it for model training. For self-hosted deployments the platform runs entirely in the customer VPC with no external data egress ('0 Bytes leave your environment'). No evidence found that Trelent itself trains on customer data, but the privacy policy PDF (app.trelent.com) was inaccessible at time of assessment, so this cannot be confirmed from the policy text directly.

flags: The vendor holds no certifications yet: its trust center explicitly states 'We are working towards compliance certifications' as of June 2026, and no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR DPA, or any other certification is publicly held.

The privacy policy PDF (app.trelent.com/TrelentPrivacyPolicy2024.pdf) was unavailable when this report was compiled because the app.trelent.com domain did not resolve; the privacy details here are drawn from the trust center and product descriptions only.
No publicly available Data Processing Agreement was found, and the trust center does not link to one.

This tool is listed under 'Docstring AI', which reflects the legacy VS Code docstring extension; the company (Trelent Inc.) has since pivoted to an enterprise private AI platform for regulated industries, so the listing name may not reflect the current product.

The SafeBase trust center is still in development: it notes 'We are currently working with experts to put together our company policies' and 'We will post our grades from public security rating agencies when they become available.' Corporate policies are not yet finalized.

Security questionnaires are available on request only; the vendor states 'We are working on our security compliance. We can provide completed questionnaires upon request.' There is no self-service security documentation.

ZDR agreements with upstream AI providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic) are documented, but Trelent's own data use practices cannot be confirmed from the privacy policy text because that document was unavailable when this report was compiled.
The company is a startup headquartered in Canada with relatively few public-facing compliance documents; its pre-certification stage is consistent with a growth-stage startup.
